title: Google security advisory (AV26-844)
content_md: Serial Number: AV26-844 Date: August 24, 2026 As of August 20, 2026, Google is affected by vulnerabilities in the following product: Chrome Prior to 151.0.7922.173 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web link and apply any necessary updates as they become available. Google Chrome Security Advisory Article Link: Google security advisory (AV26-844) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
exclude_reason: Standard Google Chrome security advisory (AV26-844) for version prior to 151.0.7922.173. Routine vendor patch notice with no substantive exploitation detail. Not worth a dedicated story.
